Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzed HGF-1 cells treated with 1.0 mg/mL of F. chilensis polysaccharides. While the broader study includes dose-response and cell-cycle assays in other cell lines (HCT-116, RAW 264.7, etc.), the MS-analyzed dataset is a pairwise comparison of treated vs untreated HGF-1 cells. The treatment is mapped to the broad 'chemical or drug treatment' category as the polysaccharides are exogenous bioactive compounds; no more specific child class in the ontology (like inhibitor or agonist) fits the general nature of fungal polysaccharides.
